job.title: Software Engineering Manager
job.description:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to know the team :

The Agent Experience team owns and operates the mission-critical internal platforms that power the end-to-end customer support and engagement ecosystem for the entire Grab superapp. Our technology directly impacts millions of users across Southeast Asia by enabling teams to seamlessly serve Passengers , Merchants, Drivers, Finance partners, and internal business lines across every vertical for support experiences

Because the entire Grab ecosystem relies on our platforms to resolve critical support issues, handle complex transactions, and protect customer trust, we design and scale our platforms to be AI-first, ultra-high availability, correctness & reliability

Get to Know the Role

We are looking for a strategic and business-driven Software Engineering Manager to guide the technical roadmap and business execution for this massive horizontal platform. In this high-impact role, you will act as a leader managing a robust organization that includes fullstack, backend, senior, and lead engineers.

You will also serve as a mentor to your teammates to help them grow. You will work onsite at CMC Creative Space, district 7, HCMC and report to the Manager, who is based in Singapore.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Lead a team of engineers across different tech stacks. You'll participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards.
  • Partner with cross functional leaders across product, design, analytics to build the product roadmap, set customer-focused metrics and experiment designs.
  • Lead the quarterly planning and build a smooth execution plan with the team for securing the delivery of product and engineering roadmap.
  • Set the engineering strategy and engineering key result targets for the team, consistently improve across testability, availability, security and code quality for your systems and modules.
  • Attract and retain senior engineering talent, actively mentor and develop engineering talent in the team and across Grab.
  • Keep your team staffing aligned with business needs and quickly pivot to changing needs
  • Growth & Coaching: Foster a high-performance engineering culture. Actively mentor, develop, and retain engineering talent at all levels, cultivating the next generation of technical leaders and managers at Grab.

Strategic Communication: Act as a functional expert and evangelist, successfully selling strategic product ideas to executive-level partners and bridging communication between technical teams and non-technical business stakeholders.

Scaling and Hiring: Keep your organization's staffing tightly aligned with evolving business needs, proactively attracting top-tier talent to sustain a complex, fast-growing engineering ecosystem.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

At least 10 years of engineering experience with

  • Organizational Scaling: Experience building and scaling complex engineering organizations.
  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Advanced expertise in distributed systems, specifically those focused on high availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Full Accountability: Experience managing platforms that serve diverse use cases and products simultaneously.
  • Cross-Vertical Support: Strategic Context: Ability to bring business context into technical decisions and benchmark performance against industry standards.
  • People Management : Experience managing a large team of junior to lead engineers/managers
  • Minimum 5+ Years of experience leading people
  • Exposure to AI-assisted or agentic development tooling
  • Strategic Authority: Ability to define the technology direction for a department and propose new ideas to bring organizational strategy.
  • Expertise and Collaboration: skills in coordinating across a vast landscape of partners to ensure seamless support for the ecosystem.
  • Cultural Understanding: A leader guided by "The Grab Way" principles: Heart, Hunger, Honour, and Humility.

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - .NET
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Software Engineer (SSE) is responsible for writing software programs, writing tests, fixing bugs, documenting technical notes, reporting status and issues, being accountable for any unit test leakage, and contributing to system architecture and design decisions.

  • To write, review and maintain code in compliance with established coding quality standard of the company
  • To write unit tests and run through all the test cases for assigned tasks and ensure all cases tested and passed before release for testing
  • To be able to securely and effectively use the AI in the SDLC and contribute to configuring AI agents
  • To implement strictly all the customer’s process if being requested, company’s processes and systems complied with CMMi standard
  • To document detailed designs as part of design team
  • Participate and contribute, if possible, to DevOps and Automation activities in some way as daily part of the project delivery such as participating in the creation of relevant DevOps/Automation testing frameworks, scripting and execution even if the specialist roles act as the focal point.
  • To self-train on new technologies
  • To coach junior members
  • To perform other tasks assigned by the Line Manager, Project Manager & Technical Manager
  • To be liable for keeping the confidentiality of all technological and business secrets of the Company during the employment


Qualifications

  • At least 3+ years’ experience
  • Good knowledge of OOP, clean code
  • Proficient C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, MVC, Web API, Entity Framework Core and SQL Server
  • Good at writing Unit Tests with mocking frameworks
  • Good knowledge of programming patterns and principles e.g Seperation of Concern, Repository Pattern, UnitOfWork, DRY, SOLID
  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Having experience of any JavaScript front-end framework e.g. Angular, React, Vue…
  • Knowledge of CMS, CRM system such as SharePoint, Microsoft Dynamics is a plus
  • Good knowledge of SQL, database design and programming
  • Good knowledge of security and performance in software development
  • Good problem-solving skill, passionate in software development or developing technical skills are preferred
  • Able to work independently, help others to solve technical issues
  • Good knowledge of code quality, coding standard and principles
  • Good knowledge of unit testing and integration test
  • Good knowledge using static coding analysis tool and properly fix violation
  • Strong understanding of coding principles like loosely coupling, dependency injection …
  • Has knowledge of containerization and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP
  • Understands DevOps practices and is able to build and maintain basic CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
  • Has knowledge of Generative AI and experience using common AI tools in SDLC, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor,…
  • Ability to review and validate the AI outputs before using it
  • Can perform code review properly
  • Can do normal documentation and presentation tasks
  • Able to understand English materials and handle normal English verbal conversation for work related matters
  • Accountable and proactive

job.title: [HN] Software Engineer (fullstack)
job.description:
Base.vn is a product-centric technology company building software platforms that help businesses operate more efficiently, improve transparency, and make data-driven decisions. We develop technology products based on three core pillars: Data & Artificial Intelligence (Data & AI), Interaction, and Open Platform. From standalone applications to complex systems, Base enables businesses to connect, integrate, and operate all their applications on a unified platform, designed to scale with real-world needs.

Our long-term vision is to lead sustainable digital transformation and AI transformation for businesses in Vietnam and global.

Today, Base products are trusted by more than 10,000 businesses across diverse industries and scales, meeting high standards for: System reliability; Scalability; Security; User experience

We believe that: The best products are built by engineers who truly understand the problem, understand the user, and take full ownership of the value their products deliver.

WHAT YOU DOAt Base, Fullstack Engineer is more than Frontend & Backend. This is the path for engineers to grow rapidly into Product Engineers - professionals who understand the problem, design the solution, and take full ownership of the products they build.

You will be involved in the entire product development lifecycle, including:

1. Understand user and business problems

  • Analyze real user needs and business contexts
  • Answer the core question: Why does this feature need to be built?

2. Design product and technical solutions

  • Participate in proposing and discussing: Business logic & Technical solutions aligned with the product context
  • Evaluate trade-offs between: Code quality; Performance; Scalability

3. Build products as a Fullstack Engineer

  • Develop Frontend, Backend, and related components
  • Ensure: High-quality, maintainable code; Product stability and scalability at production scale

4. Product ownership and responsibility

  • Take ownership of one or more modules or features, including: Monitoring performance; Analyzing usage data; Listening to and responding to user feedback
  • Proactively propose improvements based on data and real-world usage

5. Learn and grow with the team

  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
  • Be mentored by experienced Product Engineers and Tech Leads
  • Continuously develop your: Engineering skills; Product mindse; System thinking

True Engineers don’t just write code. They build products - and grow their careers through the products they build.

WHO YOU ARE

We‘re looking for talented Software Engineers to join our team with below traits:

  • Solid knowledge of Algorithms and Data Structures.
  • Strong knowledge and experience in using any programming language (PHP/NodeJS/Javascript is an advantage).
  • Knowledge or experience in using Restful API, MySQL, HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON.
  • Understanding of performance optimization or experience in real applications in production, serving large amounts of users and data - is an advantage.
  • Product Ownership Mindset: A strong desire to build products, treating what you build as your own and taking full responsibility for its success.
  • User-Centric Focus: More than just writing code - you seek to deeply understand end users and make technical decisions that optimize user experience and solve real problems end-to-end.
WHAT YOU CAN GETSpecial Benefits:
  • Attractive salary package & plus bonus based on performance
  • Flexible evaluation of salary increase (1-2 times/year) commensurate with work results
  • Opportunity to receive ESOP shares (employee stock ownership plan) for outstanding contributors
  • High performance computer and screen
  • Team building, vacation in a year, and other engagement activities
  • Other benefits as prescribed by the Labor Law


Personal Development:
  • Fast-track career: Join a full cycle of building real products for market and continuously grow with the scalability of products.
  • Unlimited learning opportunities: Enhance your expertise through a comprehensive training program, guidelines from mentors, buddies, and product development challenges.
  • Visible values & impacts: Build world-class and high-performance products that solve pain points for millions of enterprises.
  • Talented colleagues: Work with a team of enthusiastic and professional Product Builders who have already built a highly large-scale system serving 60+ millions of pageviews, hundreds of thousands users each month, and 10,000+ enterprises; and graduated from top universities in Vietnam & the world (Stanford, UCLA, HUST, etc.).


GET READY TO BE OUR SOFTWARE ENGINEER!

Apply & Job Discussion with TA

  • Round 1: Technical & Culture Interview
  • Round 2: Final Interview with CEO

Address Office: 16th floor, HUD Building, 37 Le Van Luong, Thanh Xuan, Hanoi.

job.title: AI-Native Software Engineer
job.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

MetaDefender Core is OPSWAT's file security platform, trusted where the stakes are highest: nuclear plants, defense networks, the banks that move the world's money. It's a high-performance engine, shipped everywhere from cloud and containers to on-premises and air-gapped deployments.

This role is for the engineer who would rather design the system than type every line of it: you set the architecture, a fleet of AI agents builds with you — code, tests, docs, in parallel — and you hold the one job that cannot be delegated: knowing what correct looks like, and proving it. Most companies are still debating whether their engineers may use AI. Here, it is the operating model.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Contribute to features end to end: clarify requirements, participate in design discussions, implement, test, debug, and help ship features, with ownership growing as you develop.
  • Use AI as part of your daily engineering workflow: work with tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation, while reviewing and validating AI-generated output before it ships.
  • Contribute to the team's AI-assisted development workflow: help improve agent configurations, prompt/context templates (e.g., CLAUDE.md and project rules), MCP integrations, and guardrails.
  • Write and improve tests and quality checks that verify intended behavior, catch regressions, and help make AI-generated code production-ready.
  • Build and share effective AI-assisted engineering practices with the team, including reusable prompts, workflows, and approaches for reviewing AI-generated code.
  • Develop strong debugging skills by investigating issues that cannot easily be delegated to AI, from reproducing bugs and analyzing logs to diagnosing concurrency, OS, and environment-specific problems.
  • Work across Windows and Linux environments, and gain exposure to cloud, containerized, on-premises, and air-gapped deployments.
  • Prototype and evaluate AI-powered product capabilities, such as LLM-assisted analysis, automated triage, or AI-assisted support for new integrations.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and QA to understand requirements, make technical trade-offs, and deliver reliable product features.


What We Need From You

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 1+ years of professional experience with a track record of feature ownership.
  • Good understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and common design patterns
  • Experience with multi-threaded programming and system design
  • Excellent coding and debugging skills, including comfort navigating a large existing codebase and diagnosing issues across OS boundaries (processes, services, permissions)
  • An AI-native development mindset: hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools in real development work, with the judgment to review, verify, and test AI-generated code before it ships.
  • Working knowledge of LLM fundamentals: prompt and context design, tool/function calling, evaluating outputs, and data-privacy considerations when using AI on proprietary code
  • Hands-on experience in design reviews
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts.
  • Good English is a plus point.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Development experience on Windows, Linux platforms


It Would be Nice if You Had

  • A real track record shipping and maintaining production systems, in any tech-stack.
  • Hands-on Rust or C++ - shortens your ramp, does not gate the door
  • Building AI agents or agentic pipelines yourself: tool contracts, structured output, multi-step orchestration
  • Performance profiling; networking (OSI)
  • Cybersecurity concepts, or components of a security product
  • Hands-on experience with DBMS (e.g. SQLite, PostgreSQL)
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies
